name: Checkbox
purpose: A checkbox turns one independent option on or off. A parent checkbox shows the mixed state when some of its options are on.

anatomy.role: The target: the box, the label, and the description
The control. Its fill and its mark show the state
A check for on, a dash for mixed
Help text, the count of a parent checkbox, or the cause when the checkbox is disabled

moments.when: At the change of the state, not at the end of the mark motion

clauses.text: The accessibility tree shows the control as a checkbox, with the label as its name and its state: off, on, or mixed.
Use a checkbox for an independent option, or for a change that waits for a Save button. For one option from a list, use a radio group. For a change that applies immediately, use a switch.
When the checkbox has the focus, Space changes the state. Tab moves the focus to the checkbox and away from it.
The full row is the target, with the label and the description. In the touch density, the target is 44 px high or more.
Keyboard focus shows the focus ring of the language on the box: 2 px in the ring color, 2 px from the box.
On has the accent fill and a check mark. Off has the surface fill and a border in the field line color. Color is not the only sign of the state.
A parent checkbox with a mixed selection shows a dash on the accent fill. Its description gives the count, for example 2 of 3 selected. A press on a mixed checkbox turns it on.
The box follows the control unit of the density: 16 px for pointer, 20 px for touch. The radius is a quarter of the box.
In a right-to-left layout, the box is at the right of the label.
The mark grows with spring-control. With reduced motion, the mark shows with no scale, and the change of color stays.
A change emits the moment toggle with the variant on or off, at the change of the state.
The checkbox starts a haptic or a sound directly.
A disabled checkbox has the disabled opacity and does not change. Its description tells why the option is not available.
When the checkbox is on, the form sends its value with its name.
